title: Wolf Tooth Wants You to Shop Local with Dealer-Only Shift Limited Edition Pedals in Camo Ano
content:
Wolf Tooth just unveiled its Dealer-Only Shift Limited Edition Pedals in Camo Ano ($289.95), done by Ashley Anodized It. They’re sick. They’re limited. And they’re only available at select dealers…

Bike shops are a cornerstone of the bike industry. They are cultural hubs, important third spaces, hives of knowledge, and places you know you can go for help solving a problem. This year, Wolf Tooth started a new dealer program and, along with that, a commitment to developing exclusive, dealer-only products and limited editions.

The Camo Shift Gravity Clipless Pedal is our first dealer-exclusive Limited Edition component. This is its first LTD release of 2026, available only to brick-and-mortar retailers, and is limited to only 150 pairs. Created in collaboration with the anodizing wizard Ashley Anodized It, each pedal body features a unique anodized camouflage pattern in olive, tan, black, and brown tones, finished off with a blaze orange end cap, because when you go all in, you go all in.

Wolf Tooth has pre-sold 130 pairs to dealers, which can be found below. There, you’ll find what dealers have in inventory of the Shift LTD, how many pairs they have available, and contact information for buying a pair. Customers have to visit their dealer in person or call them on the phone to buy a pair. Wolf Tooth is not allowing any online sales, in hopes of driving traffic to the brick-and-mortar bike shops that support riders in their local communities.

Limited Edition Shift Gravity Clipless Pedals are available now for $289.95 USD. Find them only at your favorite local bike shop. Check if your shop has them below, and if not, give them a call so they can order you a pair before the final 20 are sold out!
